title: Peter reminds of the truth before his death
description: Peter prepares believers for his imminent departure and wants to ensure they always remember the truth. He confirms that the message about Jesus' power and coming is not cleverly invented myths, but based on eyewitness accounts from the holy mountain where the Father's voice was heard over the Son. Peter also emphasizes that the prophetic word in Scripture does not come from human interpretation, but was spoken by people carried along by the Holy Spirit.
